description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeReportingMethodService in the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing various methods related to employee reporting hierarchies such as subordinates and supervisors.

classes.name: EmployeeReportingMethodServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for EmployeeReportingMethodService, testing hierarchy-related employee reporting functions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes EmployeeReportingMethodService instance and populates test data before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeReportingMethodDao
methods.description: Tests that the service returns an instance of EmployeeReportingMethodDao.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateListCountForEmployee
methods.description: Verifies that getSubordinateListCountForEmployee returns correct count.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateListForEmployee
methods.description: Tests retrieval of subordinate list with mock ReportTo objects.

methods.name: testGetImmediateSupervisorListForEmployee
methods.description: Tests retrieval of immediate supervisors list with mock ReportTo objects.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleAndAvailableSupervisorsIdCombinedList
methods.description: Checks the combined list of accessible and available supervisor IDs, excluding already assigned ones.

methods.name: testGetAlreadyAssignedSupervisorsSubordinatesAndSelfIdCombinedList
methods.description: Verifies combined list of supervisors, subordinates, and self ID.
